description_en: Obtains the analysis results of the Hadoop Distributed File System (HDFS) storage resources of a cluster on E-MapReduce (EMR) Doctor
description_zh: 通过EMR Doctor获取集群HDFS数据分析结果
kebab_example: aliyun emr get-doctor-hdfs-cluster --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --cluster-id c-b933c5aac8fe0000 --date-time 2023-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetDoctorHDFSCluster

parameters.help_en: Specify the date in the ISO 8601 standard. For example, 2023-01-01 represents January 1, 2023
parameters.help_zh: 其日期和时间信息以 ISO 8601 格式表示， 例如：2023年1月1日为 2023-01-01
parameters.name: date_time

HdfsScore.description_en: The overall score of HDFS storage resources
